Blaze · COMING SOON

Onsite. Fast. Bold.

Blaze — Onsite. Fast. Bold. is our developing onsite product for the teams welcoming attendees and running the event floor. Its focus is a smoother arrival experience, practical coordination and confidence during busy moments. We are shaping it around real venue workflows so staff can spend more time helping people move forward.

Our conversational vision Our goal is to make onsite tools easier to use with conversational guidance alongside clear staff workflows. Planned AI assistance supports the people running the event; the six services below remain in development.

Talk to us about Blaze

THE PRODUCT DIRECTION

Six planned onsite services, one connected event experience. We’re developing Blaze to help your team welcome people, track participation, and manage what each attendee can access or collect. These services are coming soon.

01

Scan. Print. Welcome.

Fast badge printing is the goal: scan an attendee’s QR code, retrieve their registration, and print their badge in one focused workflow.

02

Register right at the venue

Full onsite registration is planned for walk-ups and last-minute arrivals, so your team can help people register and get ready for the event at the desk.

03

Know who attended each session

Scan attendees as they enter a speaker session or class to record participation and give organizers a clearer attendance record.

04

Track attendance toward CEU credits

Help associations track attendance against their CEU requirements. The association sets the credit rules; attendance tracking does not itself provide accreditation or guarantee certification.

05

Check access at the door

Scan a badge at a controlled area and display granted or denied according to that attendee’s permissions, helping staff make consistent entry decisions.

06

Fulfill items once, with confidence

Scan a badge to see remaining item entitlements. If an attendee has three show bags remaining, staff can hand out all three and record fulfillment. A repeat scan would show those bags as already fulfilled and prevent duplicate pickup.

In development · These are planned services, not currently available features. Final capabilities and launch timing will be shared as Blaze develops.
